messages:
Alex: Quick async check — where are we on the Q2 OKR milestone 'Model routing: Canary -> GA'? Need a short status: shipped/slipped, owners for rollout, and any blocking infra/QA deps. TL;DR please.

Jamie: Quick pointer: I dropped a tiny status table in the doc -> https://redwood.app/docs/q2/model-routing but TL;DR: canary succeeded; GA blocked on autoscale + a QA replay flake. Owners: Morgan (eng), Priya (infra), Sasha (QA).

Morgan: Canary passed perf gates but we saw p99 spikes ~650ms at ~3k RPS. There's a batching regression; PR #4821 addresses it. Need Lee to finish CR.

Lee: Looking now. Left one comment about retry backoff in the PR, otherwise LGTM. If tests pass I'll approve by EOD today. :white_check_mark:

Priya: Autoscale policy is the bigger blocker for GA — scale-up is too slow under burst. Proposed change: min_instances=4, target_cpu=55, scale_step=2. I'll run infra tests in the staging window tomorrow morning.

Sasha: QA found two replay flakiness cases (seed mismatch on 99th percentile). Filed bug REDWOOD-217 with repro steps and sample logs. Need a small patch from Morgan to stabilize.

Morgan: Ack, pushed fix to branch `model-routing/fix-replay` with added unit test. CI green on my fork. @Lee PTAL so we can merge and kick a new canary.

Lee: Approved + merged. Created tag `v2.3.0-canary-fix` (sha: abc123).

DeployBot: Scheduled deployment: 1723462000 (UTC) -> cluster `dedicated-eu-west-1`. Rollout plan: 10% -> 50% -> 100% with health checks at each step.

Jamie: Product note: hold external comms until GA done. I'll prepare release notes draft and sync with marketing once we flip to GA.

Alex: Final ask for my OKR update: reply with one-line statuses (Shipped/Slipped) + owner(s) + blocker(s). Keep it short.

Morgan: Morgan: Canary ready; GA waiting. Status: Partially shipped (canary). Owner: Morgan. Blocker: autoscale perf + QA replay flake. ETA: ~2 business days.

Priya: Priya: Working autoscale change. Status: Blocker. Owner: Priya. Blocker detail: infra test window needed to validate policy. ETA: tomorrow morning.

Sasha: Sasha: QA signoff pending patch validation. Status: Blocker. Owner: Sasha. Blocker detail: need to re-run replay suite after fix. ETA: EOD.

Lee: Lee: CRs merged. Status: Ready. Owner: Lee. Blocker: none.

Jamie: Jamie: Product comms on hold. Status: Waiting. Owner: Jamie. Blocker: GA confirmation from infra/QA.

Alex: Thanks all — I'll mark milestone as 'partially shipped: canary done, GA pending infra/QA' and follow up in 48h. If anyone's blocked on time-sensitive items ping me directly. :eyes:
